purpose: 새 채팅에서도 30개 쇼츠 분석 이후의 Gemini 관찰 설계, 우라까이, CapCut 레이어 계약, 실패와 수정 이력을 그대로 이어가기 위한 기계 판독형 인계

target_workflow.goal: 쇼츠 주소 입력부터 분석, 우라까이, CapCut 프로젝트 조립까지 최대 20분 안에 한 편을 안전하게 제작

analysis_contract.urakkai_rule: 강한 장면을 복사해 앞에 붙이는 것만으로는 부족하며, 훅 이후의 장면 순서, 정보 공개 순서, TTS, 원본 대사, 자막 역할을 실제로 재설계해야 함

orchestration_contract.worker_scope: evidence, isolated candidate edit, tests only
orchestration_contract.read_write_enforcement: fresh cwd, copied read set, OS read-only flags on non-write files, prompt write allowlist, post-run diff and SHA verification
orchestration_contract.report_interval_rule: meaningful change immediately; long work no more than about one minute without concise status for this user

vertical_axis.important_distinction: physical track array order, visible timeline row order, screen compositor order, and audio lanes are different facts

capcut_two_axis_contract.optional_order_rule: A9_TEXT may be absent; if present its locked relative position must be preserved

canonical_plan_shape.v2_default_cli_rule: physical SCREEN_WHITE readback and actual visual/compositor order evidence missing means non-PASS
canonical_plan_shape.prebuild_rule: a separate explicit declaration-only gate may return DECLARED_ONLY with production_ready=false
canonical_plan_shape.production_ready_rule: only postbuild actual draft readback can allow PASS

hard_warnings: Do not promote the whole isolated workspace or whole files without approved diff review.
Do not treat track array order as visual z-order.
Do not place audio lanes in visual z-order.
Do not map ROOT_FIXED_FRAME_BACKGROUND to SCREEN_EFFECT.

Do not allow SCREEN_EFFECT to become an absolute 0-to-end layer.
Do not allow BASE_VISUAL gap or overlap.
Do not accept global_placements; canonical plan shape is timeline[].placements.
Do not return v2 production PASS when root readback or actual order evidence is NOT RUN.
Do not execute IMAGE or CARD base visuals until an executor exists.
Do not copy .worker_tmp, node cache, pyc, backup, or helper leftovers into a candidate or canonical skill.
Do not reuse a terminated worker session or workspace for a new worker.
Do not edit the live CapCut draft or canonical skill during candidate repair.
Do not call a unit-test PASS a real 20-minute episode PASS.
